CustomField.formula: HYPERLINK( '/'+CreatedById , (CreatedBy.FirstName+ CreatedBy.LastName) )+','+ (TEXT(MONTH(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) ))+ "/" + TEXT(DAY(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate)))+ "/" +TEXT(YEAR(DATEVALUE(CreatedDate))))+','+IF( OR( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 0, VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5 ), 12, 2 ) ) = 12 ), "12", TEXT( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5), 12, 2 ) ) - IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, 0, 12 ) ) ) & ":" & MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5 ), 15, 2 ) & ":" & MID( TEXT(CreatedDate - 5 ), 18, 2 ) & " " & IF( VALUE( MID( TEXT( CreatedDate - 5 ), 12, 2 ) ) < 12, "AM", "PM" )
CustomField.label: Created By
